claim: Pedagogical Framing: set attack to 0 and feel the compressor lunge, 'what the body would do without baroreceptors'; give it 200 ms and the body notices before it acts. (The DSP section says attack cannot reach 0, a ~5 ms floor; the piece would show which is true.)

pieces.what: The attack lesson: one drum loop, attack swept from its floor to 200 ms, the vessel and baroreceptors moving with it; the floor is labelled so the reader meets the 5 ms limit the text claims.
pieces.walks_up_from: the vessel at rest with no signal

pieces.what: The built face and the vessel prototype, gathered as they are.
Engine renders of each biology knob (sympathetic, vessel age, HRV) beside their input, at matched level.
